details:
Q1. What is the primary target of this request?
Choices:
A. Clarify / plan / implement workflows or their helper scripts
B. Review / autofix / orchestrator / validate behavior
C. Documentation, defaults, or operator experience
D. Another target — name the exact workflow, script, or file path (RECOMMENDED)
Q2. What is the primary improvement you want?
Choices:
A. Fix a broken or failing behavior
B. Improve reliability / reduce flakiness
C. Improve speed / reduce cost / reduce API noise
D. Improve docs / usability only
E. Another goal — describe it in one sentence (RECOMMENDED)
Q3. What concrete reference should planning use?
Choices:
A. A specific workflow run ID or run URL
B. A specific issue or PR number
C. A specific file path, workflow filename, or function name
D. No existing reference — describe the current behavior and the expected behavior in 2-3 sentences (RECOMMENDED)
